access_token.description: Alias for api_key. Defaults to API_KEY, EXCLOUD_API_KEY, EXCLOUD_ACCESS_TOKEN, ACCESS_TOKEN, or the selected organization token in ~/.exc/config.

account_id.description: Excloud account ID. Defaults to ACCOUNT_ID, EXCLOUD_ACCOUNT_ID, or default_acc from ~/.exc/config.

api_key.description: Excloud API key/token. Defaults to API_KEY, EXCLOUD_API_KEY, EXCLOUD_ACCESS_TOKEN, ACCESS_TOKEN, or the selected organization token in ~/.exc/config.

buckets_base_url.description: Override buckets API base URL. Defaults to EXCLOUD_BUCKETS_BASE_URL or SDK default.

compute_base_url.description: Override compute API base URL. Defaults to EXCLOUD_COMPUTE_BASE_URL or SDK default.

dns_base_url.description: Override DNS API base URL. Defaults to EXCLOUD_DNS_BASE_URL or https://dns.excloud.in.

email_base_url.description: Override Email API base URL. Defaults to EXCLOUD_EMAIL_BASE_URL or https://email.excloud.dev.

iam_base_url.description: Override IAM API base URL. Defaults to EXCLOUD_IAM_BASE_URL or SDK default.

id_token.description: Excloud ID token. Defaults to EXCLOUD_ID_TOKEN, ID_TOKEN, or the selected account ID token in ~/.exc/config.

load_dotenv.description: Development-only convenience: load a .env file by walking upward from the Terraform working directory. Defaults to EXCLOUD_TF_LOAD_DOTENV; disabled when unset.

org_id.description: Excloud organization ID. Defaults to ORG_ID, EXCLOUD_ORG_ID, or default_org from ~/.exc/config.

stream_base_url.description: Override Stream API base URL. Defaults to EXCLOUD_STREAM_BASE_URL or https://stream.excloud.dev.

block.description: Excloud Terraform provider. Credentials resolve from provider attributes, environment variables, and then ~/.exc/config written by the exc CLI; the selected account/org from exc login are used when provider account_id/org_id are omitted.

created_by.description: Account or principal that created the bucket.

id.description: Terraform resource ID. This is the bucket name.

is_public.description: Whether objects in the bucket are publicly readable through the public object endpoint.

name.description: Bucket name. Must be globally unique within Excloud buckets and DNS-compatible.

public_url.description: Public URL prefix when the bucket is public.

block.description: Creates and manages an Excloud S3-compatible bucket.

holder.description: Account or principal that owns the key.

id.description: Terraform resource ID. This is the S3 access key ID.

is_principal.description: Whether holder is a principal/service account.

secret_access_key.description: S3 secret access key. Returned only at creation and kept in Terraform state.

block.description: Creates and manages an Excloud bucket S3 access key. The secret access key is returned only at creation and stored in Terraform state as sensitive.

allocate_public_ipv4.description: Whether to allocate an ephemeral public IPv4.

id.description: Terraform resource ID for the VM.

instance_type.description: Excloud instance type, for example t1a.micro.

public_ipv4_reservation_id.description: Existing reserved public IPv4 ID to attach.

ssh_pubkey.description: SSH public key material or key name.

block.description: Generated resource for Excloud compute instances. Applying this resource creates billable infrastructure.

fqdn.description: Fully qualified domain name returned by the API.

name.description: Record name relative to the zone. Use @ for the zone apex.

type.description: Record type, for example A, AAAA, CNAME, TXT, MX, NS, PTR, WEIGHTED_A, WEIGHTED_AAAA, WEIGHTED_CNAME, or WEIGHTED_TXT.

value.description: Primary record value: IP address, hostname, text, or PTR target.

zone_id.description: DNS zone ID returned by the API.

zone_name.description: DNS zone name containing the record, without a trailing dot.

block.description: Creates and manages an Excloud DNS record. Supports A, AAAA, CNAME, TXT, NS, MX, PTR, and weighted A/AAAA/CNAME/TXT records.

id.description: Terraform resource ID and Excloud DNS zone ID.

name.description: DNS zone name without a trailing dot, for example example.com.

nameservers.description: Authoritative nameservers returned for the zone.

zone_type.description: DNS zone type. Currently only public zones are supported by the Excloud DNS API.

block.description: Creates and manages an Excloud DNS zone.

block.description: Manages an Excloud IAM policy. Policy documents are supplied as JSON.

account_id.description: Account ID target. Exactly one of account_id or service_account_id must be set.

service_account_id.description: Service account ID target. Exactly one of account_id or service_account_id must be set.

assumers_json.description: JSON object describing external principals allowed to assume this service account.

block.description: Manages an Excloud IAM service account.

id.description: Terraform resource ID for the public IPv4 reservation.

interface_id.description: Optional interface ID to associate during reservation.

is_assigned.description: Whether the reservation is currently assigned.

block.description: Generated resource for Excloud reserved public IPv4 addresses.

is_root.description: Whether this attachment is for the root volume.
